notes: Exclusion step finds ICD-10-CM adverse-event diagnoses in the 30 days before each patient's index date (INTCK day-window), builds an AE exclusion list from a large block of code-range predicates, and drops those patients from the cohort with a NOT IN subquery. autoexec seeds a stand-in for L0.Diagnosis and the ic3_hepatic cohort (carrying index_date, which the script reads as c.index_date); the join, INTCK window, AE range predicates, and NOT IN logic are unchanged, reading WORK.Diagnosis instead of L0.Diagnosis. Added a trailing PROC PRINT to show the final cohort.
